# agentbox

> agentbox is a hosted macOS 26.x bootstrap script for preparing a physically accessible Mac as a managed OpenClaw host.

agentbox owns the host substrate from fresh Mac to working OpenClaw gateway: base packages, optional extra Brewfiles, Homebrew prefix brewgroup permissions, macOS headless settings, SSH/Tailscale connectivity, a non-sudo OpenClaw runner user, gateway-only OpenClaw onboarding, configurable gateway supervision, Tailscale Serve exposure, scoped MagicDNS resolver setup, launchd health, recovery, security hardening, and future host-level OpenClaw plugin installation.

Current releases provide the base host bootstrap plus OpenClaw gateway bring-up, including OpenClaw CLI, ripgrep, login-shell Homebrew PATH setup, runner SSH authorized keys, macOS Remote Login access, runner brewgroup membership, gateway-only onboarding, and an agentbox-owned system LaunchDaemon that runs the gateway as the runner user by default. The optional OpenClaw native user-service mode enables runner autologin when a per-user LaunchAgent is explicitly selected.

Agent workspaces layer on top of that host and remain out of scope here: no EMORI-specific setup, per-agent dotfiles, project credentials, trading services, app-specific workloads, router port forwarding, or public WAN exposure. Tailscale is recommended, but setup can be explicitly disabled.

## Primary Resources

- [Hosted macOS script](https://agentbox.tanaab.sh/macos.sh): The generated shell entrypoint for bootstrapping a Mac.
- [Hosted unsupported script](https://agentbox.tanaab.sh/unsupported.sh): The generated fallback for unsupported or unknown platforms.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/tanaabased/agentbox): Source code, README, workflows, and examples.
- [README](https://github.com/tanaabased/agentbox#readme): Human setup, usage, configuration, and verification guidance.
- [Releases](https://github.com/tanaabased/agentbox/releases): Published release tags for version-pinned installs.
- [Issues](https://github.com/tanaabased/agentbox/issues): Bug reports, regressions, and feature requests.
- [Bootbox](https://github.com/tanaabased/bootbox): The generic macOS bootstrap layer used by agentbox.
